Ordinary content-array results are no longer Apps. Definition-only metadata remains ordinary until authenticated capture. Non-read-only transcript requests are explicitly denied, with no forwarded host capabilities. Transcript geometry uses intrinsic height, a non-shrinking availability strip, reserved resource-load height and App-reported bounded resizing. Cold resource-read timing remains separate from these corrections.

Documented complete successful result shape, ui:// scheme and 2048-character bound. The return value grants no resource authority. Other Shared exports, transport, parser and package readiness claims are unchanged; no publication claim is added.
